calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year_filter,
           18 AS week_start,
           34 AS week_end
),
web_dispatch AS (
    -- web revenue date = dispatch date in Helsinki time; cancelled and processing orders have none
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date, at the location that booked them
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year_filter
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.week_start AND params.week_end
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2;
